Terms in plain language

Editorial explanation — not a source excerpt or an eligibility check.

Commercialisation means turning an idea or research into a product or service people can use or buy. A university commercialisation office can help check the route and IP questions; this does not establish IP ownership or eligibility.

Matched contribution means funding or other resources an applicant may need to provide alongside support. Whether it applies, what qualifies and how much are not established here; check the relevant guidelines.
